title: Add an open question
description: Creates one file for an open question under project-docs/open-questions/, with a project-docs-ancestors frontmatter list and a free-text body describing what's undecided and why. Bootstraps the open-questions/README.md convention doc on first use.

question.description: A short slug for what's undecided (e.g. "Reviewer Authorization").

project.description: Scope this open question to a specific project's project-docs/open-questions/ instead of the workspace root — prefer this whenever the question already has a natural code home; only use the workspace root when it genuinely doesn't have one.

projectDocsAncestors.description: Paths to existing project-docs/ artifacts this question grounds on — an open question can ground on any artifact kind (a service description, a requirement, a specific rule). Each path must already exist; a backward reference only makes sense pointing at something already established.
